g.text: 01 / PROJECT ALPHA
Full-stack web application with modern architecture and scalable design patterns.
Built with performance and developer experience in mind.
NEXT.JS · TYPESCRIPT · POSTGRESQL · DOCKER
02 / PROJECT BETA
RESTful API service with microservice architecture and event-driven communication.
Handles high throughput with caching layers and queue-based processing.
NODE.JS · EXPRESS · REDIS · KUBERNETES · AWS
03 / PROJECT GAMMA
Real-time analytics dashboard with data visualization and customizable widgets.
Processes streaming data and renders interactive charts for decision making.
REACT · D3.JS · WEBSOCKETS · MONGODB
04 / AGENT CORE
Autonomous AI agent framework with tool-use capabilities and MCP integration.
Supports multi-step reasoning, external tool invocation, and conversation memory.
PYTHON · MCP · OPENAI · CLAUDE · HERMES
05 / LLM GATEWAY
Unified API gateway for multiple LLM providers with intelligent routing and fallback.
Manages API keys, tracks usage, and optimizes cost across providers.
FASTAPI · PYTHON · SUPABASE · SECURITY
06 / INFRA TOOLKIT
Collection of DevOps scripts and Docker configurations for rapid deployment.
Includes CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and infrastructure as code.
DOCKER · KUBERNETES · TERRAFORM · GITHUB ACTIONS
07 / PORTFOLIO SITE
Personal portfolio and blog with server-side rendering and optimized performance.
Features dark mode, responsive design, and MDX-powered blog posts.
NEXT.JS · TAILWIND · MDX · VERCEL
08 / DATA PIPELINE
ETL pipeline for processing and transforming large datasets with validation.
Handles data ingestion, transformation, and loading into analytical databases.
PYTHON · POSTGRESQL · REDIS · AIRFLOW
09 / CLI TOOLS
Developer productivity tools for the terminal with keyboard-driven interfaces.
Includes code generators, project scaffolding, and workflow automation.
NODE.JS · TYPESCRIPT · TUI · CLI
10 / HERMES AGENT
Autonomous agent capable of multi-step task execution with tool orchestration.
Integrates with external APIs, databases, and filesystem for complex workflows.
PYTHON · OPENAI · MCP · TOOL USE
11 / OPEN SOURCE CONTRIBUTIONS
Active contributor to developer tools and AI frameworks in the open source ecosystem.
Bug fixes, feature additions, and documentation improvements across multiple projects.
GITHUB · COMMUNITY · DOCUMENTATION
12 / MORE COMING SOON
Always building and exploring new technologies. Stay tuned for upcoming projects.
Check the repositories tab for the latest work and experiments.
ALWAYS LEARNING · ALWAYS BUILDING
